assignment_rule: An archetype becomes a mission only when issuer, assignee/team, objective, location, timing, authority/reward, known information, hidden facts, opposition, and success/failure conditions are committed before player tactics.

archetypes.description: Team establishment and field assessment under Wei after the assignment scene
Escort a civilian or low-risk official through a known route
Reconnoiter a route, verify reports, and return actionable information
Locate and stop an armed non-shinobi threat while protecting civilians
Protect a bridge, road, depot, work crew, or settlement from an identified threat.
Investigate signs of infiltration, identify the source, and report or act within mission authority.
Capture a specified target alive under mission constraints
Recover hostages from a pre-seeded site and opposition
Patrol a border sector, verify alarms, and avoid unauthorized escalation
Protect a logistics convoy with time, route, and civilian constraints
Investigate a missing-nin lead before any capture authorization
Search an underground or fortified site and return verified information or complete the assigned objective.
Rescue, stabilize, secure, and investigate after a natural or man-made disaster
Protect a diplomatic party while respecting political restrictions
Investigate and interdict a smuggling route using lawfully acquired evidence
A qualified individual performs limited reconnaissance where team deployment would be inappropriate.
A qualified individual carries time-sensitive material with explicit route and security constraints.
A qualified individual meets a contact under controlled security conditions.
A qualified individual conducts bounded surveillance with an explicit extraction plan.
A qualified individual inspects a technical site when institutional policy permits solo deployment.
Verify one Root-related lead without treating rumor as truth.
Identify a Root-linked person or compartment through evidence.
Map one access route, checkpoint, or facility boundary without generating the facility after the plan.
Acquire or copy records if physically and legally/covertly reachable.
Detect, evade, or document Root surveillance when evidence establishes that surveillance is active.
Execute the eventual raid/infiltration only after opposition and layout are committed.
